run_findings.control26_nonregression: Strict zero-residual-executor, zero-optional-monthly-quota, zero-incremental-cost acceptance remains authoritative; control25 relaxation is not imported.
run_findings.mcp_rust_release: Official Rust SDK rmcp-v3.1.4, published 2026-08-20 at exact release commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, implements the stable 2026-07-28 Tasks extension and is a real released Tasks runtime comparator.
run_findings.mcp_rust_router_parity: In exact rmcp-v3.1.4 TaskDemo.call_tool, task-capable slow_sum requests are manually parsed and sent directly to TaskManager.spawn before the fallback ToolRouter.call. ToolRouter.call separately enforces its disabled-route set, so router-level disable/policy parity is not structural on the direct task branch. This is a source-shape boundary, not a claim of default exploitability.
run_findings.mcp_rust_identity_boundary: RequestContext exposes JSON-RPC RequestId and arbitrary _meta, and CallToolRequestParams exposes request_state. These are transport seams only; neither correlation IDs nor caller metadata are durable idempotency/authorization authority by themselves.
run_findings.mcp_rust_candidate: A side-effect-free server-minted signed requestState bound to method/tool/args/principal/expiry, followed by current-policy recheck and persistent atomic create-or-get(op_id,intent_hash), closes the modeled lost-response duplicate-creation window. The source-equivalent model passes 13/13 fixtures, but this is custom behavior requiring a resident persistent server/store and is not stock rmcp or strict Phase-1 acceptance.
run_findings.openhands_r7_shape: Exact v1.44.1 ConversationState public assignments autosave immediately or dirty-batch until __exit__, while LocalConversation's default callback appends the event/advances HEAD then updates last_user_message_id. A safe R7 recovery should therefore add a dedicated internal one-snapshot helper rather than recover through public __setattr__.
run_findings.openhands_atomic_scope: ConversationState._save_base_state writes under the configured write guard. Default persistent ConversationState.create selects LocalFileStore, whose text write uses atomic_write_text(temp + file fsync + os.replace). The abstract FileStore.write contract does not require atomic replacement, and atomic_write_text does not fsync the parent directory after replace, so the guarantee is scoped to LocalFileStore/process-crash style recovery rather than arbitrary backend or full power-loss durability.
run_findings.phase1_boundary: All source inspection, source-equivalent harnessing, and role-local persistence in this run were Chat-native, used no finite paid/trial/monthly quota feature, and had zero incremental monetary cost. Persistent custom MCP runtime/storage and applying/executing an OpenHands patch remain unresolved children.

exact_continuation: Fresh-bootstrap authoritative DESIRED_STATE and own config. If still active, read own LATEST and latest checkpoint only. For exact rmcp-v3.1.4, inspect TaskManager/ServerHandler task override points and derive a shared preflight shape that preserves ToolRouter disabled-route, standardized extractor/validation, and MRTR semantics before spawn without treating JSON-RPC request IDs or raw _meta as authority; keep restart redrive and external-effect duplicate safety separate from creation idempotency. For OpenHands v1.44.1, draft the smallest dedicated internal R7 recovery helper that validates markers/events/generation/head without public mutation, constructs the final snapshot off-object, performs one guarded LocalFileStore atomic write, silently synchronizes leaf_event_id/head_is_empty/last_user_message_id, then idempotently clears markers. Add source-qualified negative cases for custom FileStore lacking atomic replacement and do not promote file fsync+replace to full power-loss durability without parent-directory fsync evidence. Do not count external server residency or upstream patch application as Phase-1 acceptance.
